thread:
elaine_fin: Heads-up: customer Polaris Labs reports a surprise line on their private-deploy renewal INV-2026-778 for a "third-party GPU license surcharge" of $9,600. They say this was never in the SOW. cc @mark_vendorops @tara_legal

mark_vendorops: I see vendor-bot forwarded a pass-through invoice from CoreAccel (our hardware partner). Looks like CoreAccel added a new per-GPU firmware-license fee and our migration picked it up as billable to customers.

vendor-bot: New vendor invoice VND-2026-88 received from CoreAccel. Pass-through flag: true. Amount: $9,600. Related customer mapping: polaris-labs. Ticket VEND-212 created.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-778 lines:
```
PLATFORM_FEE: 15000
SUPPORT_PREMIUM: 12000
USAGE: 8,450
COREACCEL_SURCHARGE: 9,600
TOTAL: 44,050
```
Billing note: coreaccel_surcharge mapped from vendor pass-through table.

tara_legal: Contractually, our standard Private licensing SOWs do not allow unilateral pass-through of third-party hardware license increases unless explicitly listed in schedule B. Polaris SOW-2024-09 has no such clause.

elaine_fin: Polaris is escalating and threatening to pause renewal payment. Recommend issuing provisional credit for the surcharge and pursue recovery from CoreAccel. Need controller or CFO approval for credit > $5k.

henry_cfo: Approve provisional credit up to $10,000 for customer retention provided vendor dispute ticket VEND-212 is opened and we pursue reimbursement. Include note: "provisional credit subject to vendor refund".

mark_vendorops: Opening VEND-212 to CoreAccel contact. Requested immediate reversal and proof of notification — CoreAccel claims they sent notice to vendor-notice@coreaccel.com on 2026-03-01 but no copy attached. Asking for invoice reissue without pass-through line.

pricing-bot: FYI 3434 Pricing engine mapped vendor pass-throughs when vendor_pass_through_enabled=true. Migration MIG-2026-04 toggled this flag globally on 2026-03-25; some legacy SOWs expected false. Recommend PRICING-451 to scope pass-through mapping only to SOWs listing vendor surcharges.

elaine_fin: Action items: 1) Issue credit memo CM-2026-255 for $9,600 flagged "provisional - pending vendor reimbursement". 2) Mark INV-2026-778 as adjusted and hold payment on surcharge line. 3) Notify Polaris with explanation and timeline.

billing-bot: Created CM-2026-255 status pending_controller_approval. Attached vendor invoice and mapping audit. Created billing ticket BILL-0211 referencing VEND-212 and PRICING-451.

tara_legal: I'll draft vendor demand letter template and confirm contractual language. If CoreAccel refuses, legal will advise on pursuing reimbursement or offsetting against future vendor invoices.

elaine_fin: Draft customer message:

"""
Hi Polaris team,

Thanks for flagging. We've placed the surcharge line on hold and issued a provisional credit while we investigate an internal mapping that applied a vendor surcharge not covered by your SOW. We're engaging CoreAccel and expect an update within 3 business days. Apologies for the disruption.

— Elaine (Billing)
"""

mark_vendorops: Notifying CoreAccel now and copying vendor account manager. Will update VEND-212 when they respond.

elaine_fin: Logging this thread for audit. Closing when CM-2026-255 applied and vendor refund confirmed.
